gaps.summary: Production PostgreSQL backup/PITR configuration, isolated restore and measured RPO/RTO drill evidence are not yet executed. Targets alone are not PASS evidence.

Production object versioning/replication, cross-scope restore and checksum verification adapter/drill remain uncomposed. Recovery core already treats bucket/key/size/SHA-256 as truth and rejects signed URLs.

Production NODE-19 redispatch adapter and empty-broker rebuild drill are not yet composed. Generic recovery only marks proven safe jobs REQUEUE_SAFE; paid-capable jobs without durable idempotency evidence require review.
Production Agent checkpoint resume adapter and restart drill are not yet composed. Core requires exact graph definition hash compatibility and preserves waiting_user instead of auto-resuming it.
Provider-specific poll/materialize reconciliation adapters and callback-loss drills remain required. Existing provider_request_id must be reused; unknown paid side effects never auto-rerun.
Immutable recovery drill/action evidence persistence and measured DB/Object/worker/provider/deploy/site-failure reports remain to be added after the exact current Alembic head is verified.
Production application/schema rollback, forward-fix compatibility matrix and blue/green or canary recovery drill remain unverified.
Regional/site failover, DNS/control-plane recovery, secret/config restore and external dependency degradation drills remain unverified.
Operator runbooks, escalation ownership and scheduled tabletop/live recovery exercises require production review and execution evidence.
Latest-head NODE-68 pytest/Ruff/Pyright/PostgreSQL recovery validation must actually execute. Pre-run/skipped GitHub Actions jobs are not PASS.
Durable-evidence recovery dispositions are implemented for runtime jobs, idempotency operations, Agent control/checkpoint evidence and Artifact object verification.

Known native provider requests are classified for reconciliation with preserved operation/provider ids; paid ambiguous side effects are REVIEW_REQUIRED and generic recovery does not submit replacements.
Agent recovery validates exact graph definition hash/enabled state and checkpoint presence before RESUME_SAFE; waiting_user remains untouched.
Artifact object recovery evidence is internal bucket/key/size/SHA-256 only and signed/public URL references are rejected.
